Why We Built ELDER EASE

Being Far Away Shouldn't Mean Being Unable to Help.

Millions of older adults live independently while their sons and daughters work in distant cities. When an unexpected moment happens at home, every minute of silence feels overwhelming.

Home: Quiet Evening Alone Another City: Wondering If Everything Is Okay
The Silent Gap in Modern Family Care

Complex devices often sit on a nightstand when they are needed most.

Conventional smartwatches demand daily charging, tiny touchscreens, and multi-layered menus. For an elderly parent experiencing dizziness or a sudden fall, navigating a miniature screen is impractical—and for children living in another city, unanswered phone calls create constant anxiety.

"We needed something so comfortable and effortless that our parents would never take it off—and so direct that one press reaches family and nearby help immediately."

Living Alone

Many seniors spend long hours at home by themselves without someone nearby to notice sudden changes in mobility or well-being.

Sudden Falls

A slip in the hallway or bathroom can happen in seconds, often leaving an older adult unable to reach a telephone on a table across the room.

Delayed Emergency Assistance

Without an immediate alert mechanism worn on the body, hours can pass before a family member or neighbour realizes help is needed.

Forgotten Medicines

Daily schedules for blood pressure, heart, or diabetes medications are easy to miss without gentle, unmistakable wrist reminders.

Difficulty Contacting Family

Unlocking a smartphone, finding contacts, or dialling numbers during stress or low vision can prevent timely communication.

Children Living in Different Cities

Adult children balancing careers and families in other cities need reliable peace of mind and instant alerts when their parents need support.

Introducing ELDER EASE

One Simple Band. A Stronger Connection.

ELDER EASE is a thin, elegant black ribbon-style smart safety band designed specifically for elderly people. By replacing fragile screens with a soft woven strap and a single unmistakable SOS button, safety becomes effortless to wear day and night.

Soft black fabric & breathable silicone ribbon strip engineered for 24/7 comfort without wrist fatigue.

Easy-to-Use SOS Button

One prominent central push button with a raised tactile ring—operable even in the dark or with reduced vision.

Fall Detection

Integrated motion sensors detect sudden impact and orientation changes to initiate alert workflows.

Judge's Evaluation & Fail-Safe Defense

Engineered for the "What Ifs" Judges Ask First.

In real life, emergencies don't wait for full batteries, strong Wi-Fi, or children living in the same city. Here is how ELDER EASE solves the four hardest edge cases in senior safety—test each interactive fail-safe simulator below.

Fail-Safe Solution 01 • Simultaneous Local + Distant Escalation

The Distant Child Coordinates; The Local Proximity Circle Arrives in Under 3 Minutes.

Alerting only a son or daughter in Bengaluru when a parent falls in Jamshedpur isn't enough if nobody near the house knows. ELDER EASE uses a 3-Ring Simultaneous Escalation Protocol:

Ring 1 (0–10 Seconds): Local Proximity Guardians

Simultaneously pings pre-registered next-door neighbours, apartment security guards, or society desk within 200m with a temporary emergency door-access code.

Ring 2 (10–30 Seconds): One-Tap Remote Local Dispatch

The distant child's app displays a single "Dispatch Hospital Ambulance Near Parent" button pre-mapped to the parent's home GPS and medical history—saving crucial minutes of searching local numbers.

Ring 3 (60-Second Unanswered Auto-Escalation)

If the primary child is in a flight or meeting and doesn't acknowledge within 60 seconds, the system automatically escalates to secondary relatives and local emergency contacts.

Live 1,500 km Rescue Simulation

T + 03 sec • Local Guardian (Flat 4B Neighbour, 15m away) WALKING TO DOOR

Fail-Safe Solution 02 • Dual-Core Reserve Battery Vault

Even at 0% Main Battery, the Isolated +72-Hour Reserve SOS Vault Takes Over.

Judges always ask: "What if the elderly person forgets to charge the band?" Unlike smartwatches that become dead weights at 0%, ELDER EASE partitions its power into two physically isolated battery domains:

  • 01. Primary Rechargeable Cell (14-Day Routine Care): Powers daily Bluetooth sync, haptic medicine reminders, and optional heart-rate sensing.
  • 02. Hardware MOSFET Power-Gate at 0%: When the primary cell drains to 0% (after sending 20% and 10% alerts to the family app), routine features shut off automatically.
  • 03. Dedicated Solid-State Reserve SOS Micro-Vault (+72 Hours): Physically wired exclusively to the mechanical SOS switch, ultra-low-power fall interrupt, and emergency burst transmitter—guaranteeing emergency calls work days after the main battery reads 0%.

Fail-Safe Solution 03 • 4-Layer Offline & Dead-Zone Relay

No Wi-Fi? Phone in Another Room? Offline 2G SMS Burst & Local Beacon Take Over.

Internet routers fail during storms, and seniors rarely carry their smartphones into the bathroom or garden. ELDER EASE cascades automatically across four independent communication channels:

Channel 1 • BLE 5.3 Long-Range

Penetrates multiple concrete walls across the home to reach the companion phone or home plug hub.

Channel 2 • Zero-Internet 2G SMS Burst

When Wi-Fi/4G data is down, PRO model sends a 140-byte compressed coordinate SMS over basic 2G voice towers.

Channel 3 • Neighbour BLE Mesh Relay

Encrypted SOS beacon packets relay through any registered neighbour's or building guard's phone in range.

Channel 4 • 85dB Siren + Strobe

In total underground or basement dead zones, it triggers a high-decibel piezoelectric distress chime + high-visibility LED strobe.

Simulate Network Outage Conditions: Auto-Failover Active
SCENARIO: HOME WI-FI & BROADBAND DOWN Delivered in 1.8s

Primary Wi-Fi failed → Band automatically routes emergency packet via Cellular 2G/GSM SMS Burst + Companion Mobile Data. Family & local neighbour receive exact GPS coordinates via SMS link even without internet.

Fail-Safe Solution 04 • Two-Stage Sensor Fusion + 10s Grace Window

Zero "Boy Who Cried Wolf" Fatigue: 10-Second Haptic Pre-Alert Filters False Triggers.

If a device sends false alarms every time an elderly person claps, sits down briskly, or drops the strap on a table, families stop trusting it. ELDER EASE eliminates false alarms through a 3-step verification pipeline:

  1. 1. Recessed Beveled SOS Guard: The central SOS button sits inside a 1.2mm protective tactile ring so leaning against a pillow or table never depresses it accidentally.
  2. 2. Impact + Post-Fall Stillness Signature: Our IMU algorithm checks not just for sudden G-force acceleration, but also for horizontal orientation change followed by post-impact immobility.
  3. 3. 10-Second Haptic Cancellation Window: Before alerting the family, the band pulses gently for 10 seconds. If the wearer is fine, a single tap cancels the alert locally; if they are unconscious or unable to move, the alert dispatches automatically at second 10.
False-Alarm Rejection Pipeline
Step A 3-Axis G-Force + Angle Check
Step B 10s Wrist Vibration Grace
Step C Auto-Dispatch if No Cancel

Result: High sensitivity to real falls with near-zero nuisance alerts for distant family members.

Our Vision & Mission

Technology With a Human Purpose.

Our mission is to make everyday life safer and more reassuring for elderly people by connecting them with their families through simple wearable technology.

We believe the best assistive technology never intimidates the person wearing it. By stripping away distracting screens and complex interfaces, ELDER EASE honours the dignity and independence of older adults while giving sons, daughters, and caregivers across cities a reliable bridge of care.
